commonButtons.label: Read more about Retail media CMS

hero.title: The only in-store CMS built for retail media.
hero.description: Stores, screens, ad formats, playlists, campaigns, playback logs, reports - one console. Retailers turn screens into revenue. Brands buy targeted in-store inventory.
stats: 6 weeks from pilot to live network

features.title: Smart playlists with dayparting
features.description: Brands target peak shopping hours and weekend traffic. Retailers automate seasonal scheduling. Rules-based playlists generate by time, day, location, or trigger.

features.title: Multi-zone artboard editor
features.description: Brands ship campaigns same-day from brand-locked templates. Retailers control the visual layer. Drag-and-drop editor, stock assets, Canva and PowerPoint import.

features.title: Real-time screen health
features.description: Brands trust ads actually played. Retailers fix issues fast. Heartbeat per screen, offline alerts, screenshot capture, remote reboot, brightness control.

items.title: Screen Planogram
items.description: A live map of your whole estate, with status, format, and placement context in one view.

items.title: Booking Calendar
items.description: Plan, price, and book inventory across screens and physical placements, one workflow for every in-store campaign.

items.title: Physical Media
items.description: Manage every analog placement as bookable inventory, floor decals, standees, wobblers, food demos, and end-caps.
